questions.question: When God told Moses to take a census of Israel in the wilderness, who was to be counted?

answers.text: Men twenty or older who can serve in the army
Men thirty or older who can serve at the tent
Every firstborn son from every single family

questions.question: God told the Levites to camp around the tabernacle and watch over it. What reason did He give?

answers.text: So no wrath falls on Israel
So no enemy carries it off
So the other tribes can rest

questions.question: When God told Moses not to count the Levites in the census, what did He appoint them over?

answers.text: The tabernacle and everything in it
The army and everything in it
The storehouse and everything in it
